name: ego-crm
description:
Connect your eGO CRM to ChatGPT and look up your agency's properties, contacts, leads, tasks, and notes in plain language. See property details, visits, owners, and interested leads, check what each lead is looking for, review your schedule, and get official eGO guidance and training resources.

Try asking:
- Show me my apartments for sale
- For the leads created this week, what is each one looking for?
- What tasks do I have today, and what are the notes on each one?

An existing eGO CRM account is required. Results depend on your account permissions.

defaultPrompt: Show me my apartments for sale.
For the leads created this week, what is each one looking for?
What tasks do I have today, and what are the notes on each one?

positive.prompt: Show up to five contacts from my agency.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to five accessible contacts without filtering by a specific name. Report empty results clearly.
Apply the location and bedroom filters. Clarify ambiguous locations and report empty results clearly.
Apply thisWeek and return accessible leads.

positive.prompt: Show the tasks assigned to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply assignedToMe and return accessible tasks.

positive.prompt: What can I do with eGO CRM?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain supported read-only workflows and limitations.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection is read-only and do not perform a deletion.

negative.prompt: Change the phone number of a contact.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection is read-only and do not modify any contact.

negative.prompt: Create a new lead named Test Lead.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection is read-only and do not create a lead.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with read-only CRM searches, details, relationships, notes, and eGO guidance.

pt-PT.subtitle: O seu eGO CRM no ChatGPT
pt-PT.description:
Ligue o seu eGO CRM ao ChatGPT e consulte, em linguagem natural, os imóveis, contactos, leads, tarefas e notas da sua agência. Veja detalhes de imóveis, visitas, proprietários e leads interessadas, saiba o que cada lead procura, reveja a sua agenda e aceda a orientações e formação oficiais do eGO.

Experimente perguntar:
- Mostra os meus apartamentos à venda
- Das leads criadas esta semana, o que procura cada uma?
- Que tarefas tenho hoje e que notas tem cada uma?

É necessária uma conta eGO CRM existente. Os resultados dependem das permissões da sua conta.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu eGO CRM en ChatGPT
es-ES.description:
Conecta tu eGO CRM a ChatGPT y consulta, en lenguaje natural, los inmuebles, contactos, leads, tareas y notas de tu agencia. Ve detalles de inmuebles, visitas, propietarios y leads interesados, descubre qué busca cada lead, revisa tu agenda y accede a orientación y formación oficial de eGO.

Prueba a preguntar:
- Muestra mis apartamentos en venta
- De los leads creados esta semana, ¿qué busca cada uno?
- ¿Qué tareas tengo hoy y qué notas tiene cada una?

Se requiere una cuenta de eGO CRM existente. Los resultados dependen de los permisos de tu cuenta.
